name: Stagnant Oasis
summary: Kolkar centaur guard the Stagnant Oasis in the dry heart of the Barrens. Its waters lie between the Gold Road and Merchant Coast, drawing wildlife to its banks.

sections.title: A Murky Haven in the Drought
sections.body: East of the Gold Road, inland from the Merchant Coast, the Stagnant Oasis breaks up the dusty scrub of the Barrens. Dense foliage grows around the pool, where aggressive snapjaw turtles prowl. Weakened kodos often stray here from the great herds of the Field of Giants. Kolkar centaur keep camps along the banks and fiercely guard the water from anyone entering their territory.

sections.title: Strange Waters
sections.body: Strange life stirs in the pool, though its waters look still. Deviate Fish swim among other unusual creatures. Scholars and shamans watch the Barrens oases closely, studying the strange forces that affect local springheads and the wildlife that drinks from them.

faq.q: Where is the Stagnant Oasis located?
faq.answer: The Stagnant Oasis lies in the central-southern Barrens, east of the Gold Road and west of the cliffs along the Merchant Coast.
Kolkar centaur have camps around the pool. Oasis Snapjaws and solitary, wandering kodos also roam the greenery nearby.

faq.q: Why are the kodos here easier to hunt?
faq.answer: Kodos near the Stagnant Oasis are often solitary, weakened, or lost, unlike the great, coordinated herds farther south in the Field of Giants. That makes them easier prey for hunters and travelers.

faq.q: What kind of fish can be caught in the pool?
faq.answer: Anglers can catch Deviate Fish in the murky pool. The fish can be cooked into delicacies prized across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Did Thrall visit this oasis during the Long March?
faq.answer: No record confirms whether Thrall visited the Stagnant Oasis. It may have been one of the three watering holes Thrall and the newly arrived Horde secured while marching across the Barrens with Cairne Bloodhoof.

angles.text: The Stagnant Oasis yields rare Deviate Fish, the essential ingredient for Savory Deviate Delights.
Horde couriers and scouts traveling between Crossroads and Taurajo face a constant threat from the centaur camps at the oasis, which menace supply traffic on the Gold Road.
